title: 第十章 这难度一下子就三级跳了吧
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
“……………”
最怕空气突然安静。
方正沉默的注视着眼前的魔女，而玛格妲也一言不发的看着他，在片刻之后，玛格妲这才冷笑一声。
“原来是一只不小心打错洞的小老鼠，看来你的运气真的很不好啊。”
一面暗中内心咒骂，方正一面向着四周望去。他现在的情况可谓是非常糟糕，左侧的肩膀火辣辣的疼痛，身上也到处都是伤，可以说是浑身酸软几乎没有半点儿力气。而自己所在的又是一个宽广的大厅，放眼望去四周连个遮蔽物都找不到。又被几十个邪教徒包围不说，后面还有BOSS在虎视眈眈。
我只是来找个道具，怎么一下子就BOSS战了呢？
这难度一下子就三级跳了吧！
此刻的方正也是面色阴晴不定，但是还没有等他想好该如何搞定眼前的麻烦，就看见那悬浮在空中的魔女面色猛然一变。
“我感觉到你怀里有一股奇特的力量波动………原来如此，那东西在你的手里，把它交给我！”
说道最后，魔女猛然提高了声音，这也让方正感觉到自己的耳边仿佛被无数的铜锣猛然敲打了一般，只觉得头晕眼花，一时间甚至连话都说不出来。刚刚站起来的身体也仿佛被人猛然击倒了一般，重新跪倒在地。
“你们去抓住他！把他怀里的东西拿来给我！”
玛格妲并没有和方正废话的意思，毕竟在她眼中，方正只是一个民兵，虽然对于这个民兵是如何出现在自己面前的有点儿好奇，可是在暗黑世界里，这种蝼蚁从来就不是玛格妲所需要去关心的对象。而那些邪教徒在听到自己主人的命令之后，便举步向着方正走了过来，在他们眼中，一个身受重伤，连动都没有办法动的民兵，根本没有任何威胁。
“哈啊………哈啊………”
紧握着霜之哀伤，方正这会儿依旧半跪在地上大口的喘息着，他的脑中嗡嗡作响，眼前所看见的一切也是模糊不清，那些邪教徒在方正眼中只能够看见一个个晃动的黑影。
难道我要死在这里吗？
肺部火辣辣的疼痛，每喘一口气都感觉仿佛有火焰在自己的胸口燃烧一般。方正抬起头来，看着那些模糊的黑影正在向着自己逐渐靠近，他现在甚至看不清楚那些邪教徒的装束，但是他知道，面对这么多的邪教徒，以目前的自己来说，是没有任何还手之力的。
那么，剩下的办法就只有一个了。
想到这里，方正握紧了手中的长剑。
就在邪教徒接近方正之时，呼啸的寒风平地而起。
“———————！！”

冰冷寒意在一瞬间掠过了那些邪教徒的身体，而这些邪教徒却丝毫没有察觉。他们只是保持着自己之前的动作，但是整个人却好像时间被停止般停在了原地，很快，他们的皮肤上开始浮现出了一层层白色的霜冻，而他们眼中的灵魂之火，也在瞬间熄灭。
“这是什么？！！”
看着眼前这忽如其来的一幕，玛格妲顿时大吃一惊，她急忙举起双手，伴随着玛格妲的动作，血红的魔法阵在她的身侧浮现，很快，一道半透明的红色屏障将玛格妲包裹其中。但即便如此，那冰冷的寒风还是瞬间就将她轰飞了出去，连同四周插在墙壁上的火把，也在这狂啸的暴风之中彻底熄灭。
一时间，四周陷入了一片黑暗。
“咳………咳咳………”
这是什么力量？
玛格妲一面擦拭着嘴角的鲜血，一面惊疑不定的望向前方。她原本以为方正只是一个普通的民兵，但刚才在自己眼前所发生的一切让玛格妲已经不再确定这一点，她可以感觉到一股强大无比的，充满了死亡与冰冷的力量正在降临。这怎么可能？难道说，对方也是某个地狱魔王的侍从吗？怎么会这样？为什么彼列大人没有告诉自己！？
玛格妲发誓，如果她早就知道有其他的地狱魔王插手其中的话，她一定不会这么轻视的！
但是现在，一切都晚了！
“呼。”
原本熄灭的火把再次被点亮，只不过这一次，它燃烧的不再是原本的火焰，而是青绿色的灵魂之火。
“不过如此…………”
低沉的声音响起，气温开始骤然下降，虽然有鲜血屏障的庇护，但是玛格妲依然瑟瑟发抖。她可以感觉到，一个自己根本无法抵抗的存在已然降临，此刻整个地下大厅已经完全变成了另外一个模样，原本布满了鲜血和尸体的地面已经完全被冰霜所覆盖，甚至就连四周的天花板上，也到处都是冰棱。整个地下大厅，眨眼之间就化为了一片冰天雪地的世界。

content_en:
"…………"
I'm most afraid of the sudden silence in the air.
Fang Zheng stared at the witch in front of him silently, and Magda also looked at him without saying a word. After a moment, Magda sneered.
"It turned out to be a little mouse that accidentally dug the wrong hole. It seems that you are really unlucky."
Cursing secretly in his heart, Fang Zheng looked around. His current condition is very bad. His left shoulder is in burning pain, and there are injuries all over his body. It can be said that his whole body is so weak that he has almost no strength at all. And the hall he was in was a wide one. Looking around, he couldn't find any shelter. Not only was he surrounded by dozens of cultists, but there was also a BOSS watching from behind.
I was just looking for a prop, why was there a BOSS fight all of a sudden?
This level of difficulty suddenly jumped three levels!
At this moment, Fang Zheng also had a gloomy expression, but before he could figure out how to deal with the trouble at hand, he saw the expression of the witch suspended in the air suddenly change.
"I feel a strange power fluctuation in your arms... I see, that thing is in your hands, give it to me!"
At the end of her speech, the witch suddenly raised her voice, which made Fang Zheng feel as if his ears were being struck by countless gongs. He felt dizzy and couldn't even speak for a while. The body that had just stood up seemed to have been knocked down suddenly, and fell to the ground again.
"Go and catch him! Bring me what he has in his arms!"
Magda had no intention of talking nonsense with Fang Zheng. After all, in her eyes, Fang Zheng was just a militiaman. Although she was a little curious about how this militiaman appeared in front of her, in the dark world, such ants were never the ones Magda needed to care about. After hearing the order from their master, the cultists walked towards Fang Zheng. In their eyes, a militiaman who was seriously injured and couldn't even move was no threat at all.
"Haah...haah..."
Holding Frostmourne tightly, Fang Zheng was still half-kneeling on the ground, breathing heavily. His mind was buzzing, and everything he saw in front of him was blurry. The cultists could only see shaking black shadows in Fang Zheng's eyes.
Am I going to die here?
There was burning pain in my lungs, and every time I took a breath, I felt like there was a fire burning in my chest. Fang Zheng raised his head and watched the blurry black figures approaching him. He couldn't even see clearly the costumes of the cultists, but he knew that facing so many cultists, he currently had no power to fight back.
Then, there is only one way left.
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng tightened his grip on the sword in his hand.
Just as the cultists were approaching Fangzheng, a howling cold wind rose from the ground.
“——————!!”
The cold chill passed through the bodies of those cultists in an instant, but these cultists did not notice it at all. They just maintained their previous movements, but their whole bodies seemed to have stopped in place. Soon, layers of white frost began to appear on their skin, and the soul fire in their eyes was extinguished in an instant.
"What is this?!!"
Seeing the sudden scene in front of her, Magda was immediately shocked. She hurriedly raised her hands. Following Magda's movements, a blood-red magic circle emerged around her side. Soon, a translucent red barrier enveloped Magda. But even so, the icy cold wind blew her away in an instant, and the torches stuck on the walls were completely extinguished in the howling wind.
For a moment, the surroundings fell into darkness.
"Cough...cough cough..."
what force is thisquantity?
Magda wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and looked forward in surprise. She originally thought that Fang Zheng was just an ordinary militiaman, but what happened in front of her just now made Magda no longer sure of this. She could feel an extremely powerful force, full of death and coldness, coming. How is this possible? Could it be that the other party is also a servant of a certain hell demon king? how so? Why didn’t Lord Belial tell him! ?
Magda swore that if she had known that other hell demons were involved, she would not have taken it so lightly!
But now, it's too late!
"Huh."
The originally extinguished torch was lit again, but this time, it was no longer burning the original flame, but the green soul fire.
"It's just that..."
A low voice sounded, and the temperature began to drop suddenly. Although she was protected by the blood barrier, Magda was still shivering. She could feel that a being that she could not resist had arrived. At this moment, the entire underground hall had completely changed into a different appearance. The ground that was originally covered with blood and corpses had been completely covered by frost, and even the surrounding ceilings were covered with ice edges. The entire underground hall turned into a world of ice and snow in the blink of an eye.
